_comment: Whether a spec asked to choose between the approaches its analysis finds.
`aide-run-spec` reads it off the spec's own 1-description.md (aide_spec_choose_approach)
to tell analyze; the dashboard reads the same line (chooseApproachIn) to decide whether
a choice waits on the spec's row.
`description` is the value written after `- **Let me choose the approach:**` in the
description's Tracking info; null means the line is not written at all.
`chosen` is what both sides read: only `yes` is yes, absent or unknown is no.
